sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual held original, sections 1-4, preamble and signature on PDF page 1. Agricultural material and contents excluded. Section 4 opening visibly garbled; no reconstructed reading claimed.
sources_checked.finding: Section 1 defines foreign data. Section 2 requires State to obtain requested foreign data through Foreign Service. Section 3 directs maintenance of a comprehensive data statement, transmission/prioritization standards and agency consultation. Section 4 deals with priorities, resource limits and requesting-agency priorities, but exact opening wording requires original image. No express activation or own sunset seen; signature June 4, 1951 is not asserted as independently sourced effectiveness.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order, all sections 1-11 and signature, PDF pages 11-12.
sources_checked.finding: Section 10(e) formally revokes EO10249. Section 11 supplies 1981-02-15 effective date, distinct from February 23 signature. Preamble supplies concrete 1980 Act replacement lead. No general savings settles former EO10249 instruments.

sources_checked.read_extent: Complete actual order through signature, PDF pages 5-7; blank page 8 and neighboring rules page 9 excluded.
sources_checked.finding: Section 41(b) runs from agencies to personnel boards and concerns board cognizance. Distinct from State obtaining foreign data for requesting agencies. Section 42 savings are scoped to functions affected by this order; no blanket EO10249 continuation. Section 43 expressly effective 1966-01-01; signature OCR says 1966 despite January publication. That signature inconsistency is not used to date an EO10249 event.
